# `surrogate_lagfree_pairs`

per burst, the lagged share of its sensors' second moment against lag-free Wishart draws of its own zero-lag second moment.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_pairs --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_pairs --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_pairs --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --windows "rest time grid band 8-12 Hz" --bursts "rest alpha bursts" --psd rest_psd_welch --band "[8, 12]"
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `bursts` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$bursts"} | yes |
| `psd` | statistic welch, where {"name": "$psd"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `windows` | `--windows` | none | - |  | the band's time grid whose members carry the complex measurement `sum` of z z^H ("<recording> time grid band 8-12 Hz"; `run measure --set analytic_cross_spectrum_tiles` first) |
| `bursts` | `--bursts` | none | - |  | the bursts (a spans selection on the recording's time line) |
| `psd` | `--psd` | none | - |  | the recording's Welch PSD (its bandwidth through the band's gain gives the dof) |
| `band` | `--band` | none | Hz |  | the band [lo, hi] |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - | morlet, meyer | the band's analytic gain: morlet \| meyer |
| `draws` | `--draws` | `1000` | - |  | the lag-free Wishart draws a burst (at least 20) |
| `seed` | `--seed` | `0` | - |  | the draws' seed |
| `name` | `--name` | `surrogate_lagfree_pairs.{bursts}` | - |  | the per-burst measurement's name; the run's statistic is <name>.run |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE LAG-FREE PAIRS SURROGATE OF THE BURSTS' LAGGED SHARE (spec docs/specs/2026-11-17-surrogates.md; a measurement over the bursts and a statistic of the recording): per burst, the analytic windows wholly inside it summed
(its sensors' second moment Q), the lagged share |Im Q|^2 / |Q|^2, and the same share under lag-free Wishart draws of the burst's own zero-lag second moment (Re Q) with dof = its duration x the band's
effective bandwidth (the PSD's through the band's analytic gain): the p and the BH q over the bursts; and the run's mean share against the draws'. A SENSOR-level test: a burst beyond the surrogate has lags
beyond sampling noise, not a wave. The analytic windows come first (`nxr-neuro run measure --set analytic_cross_spectrum_tiles`: the complex measurement `sum` over the band's time grid), `windows` names that grid ("<recording> time grid band 8-12 Hz"); the bursts and the recording's Welch PSD too.

  nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_pairs --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --windows "rest time grid band 8-12 Hz" --bursts "rest alpha bursts" --psd rest_psd_welch --band "[8, 12]"
```
